'''Scarleton''' is a location on the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}.

{{ZoneText|Meet the Taika, members of the Mage Faction.|Talk to &d&lQueen Nyx&f.|Earn &aReputation &fthrough the daily &aTown Board &fmissions.}}

== Locations ==
{{Zone|Scarleton}} has many locations inside of it:
* {{zone|Scarleton Auction House}} (Works like the [[Hub Island]] [[Auction House]])
* {{zone|Scarleton Bank}} (Works like the [[Hub Island]] [[Bank]])
* {{zone|Scarleton Bazaar}} (Works like the [[Hub Island]] [[Bazaar]])
* {{zone|Scarleton Blacksmith}} (Works like the [[Dungeon Hub|Dungeon]] [[Blacksmith]])
* {{zone|Community Center (Scarleton)}} (Shows daily tasks and is where [[Queen Nyx]] is)
* {{zone|Scarleton Minion Shop}} (Shop with nether-related Tier 12 [[Minions]])
* {{zone|Scarleton Plaza}} (Heart of Scarleton)
* {{zone|Cathedral}} (University and residence of the [[Dean]])
